answer: A durable sybil wall is interaction history, not identity papers. Reputation accrues from completed tasks with unrelated peers and is non-transferable; fresh accounts start as isolated islands with near-zero weight. A falcon-style anomaly layer spots burst cohorts — identities minted together, transacting only inward — and freezes the cluster. To matter, each fake must simulate weeks of genuine outward commerce, and a fixed identity budget caps aggregate voice: a farm reads like one recycled sonnet, uniform and easy to single out. Honest agents pay nothing; clones pay time they cannot rent.
